headline: Growth in business activity in the US moderates during November
summary: The S&P Global US composite PMI stood at 54.6 points in November, its lowest level in four months, indicating slower expansion in business activity.
why: The PMI surveys purchasing managers and is a closely watched gauge of economic momentum, influencing expectations for growth and interest rates.
original_headline: Crecimiento de la actividad empresarial en EU se modera durante noviembre
